name: A level 80 character can enter Wrath Naxxramas below the Classic release ladder's final stage (#9579)
contract: AscensionRaidReleasePolicy.h gates raids by map id. In the 3.3.5 client, map 533 is the Wrath 10/25-man
Naxxramas reached through the Dragonblight entrance; MapDifficulty.dbc exposes only its four Wrath raid
difficulties (0-3) for that map id, with no separate Classic 40-man mode. The ladder's Classic-tier gate
(StageNaxxramas, reached at Ascension.CallboardCache.ReleaseStage 8) must not close map 533, unlike before
the fix, while every other Wrath raid (here Ulduar, map 603) stays open at any stage, below or above it.

steps.label: CONTROL: an unrelated Wrath raid is open at this low release stage
Back to the starting spot before the discriminating attempt
DISCRIMINATING: enter Wrath Naxxramas through its Dragonblight entrance at the default low release stage
DISCRIMINATING: Naxxramas entry succeeds instead of staying closed
